probe: Deterministic asymmetric RGB and 39 numeric columns; finite mask excludes a known block and one partial-channel edge, separate eligibility mask.

reference_dispatch.acceptance: All five explicit v2 grids must pass with both reference dispatches. The v1 control is checked with matched MATH, and its full default-dispatch diagnostics are reported independently.
reference_dispatch.cases: Meta reference and released scorer both use PyTorch SDPA MATH, the explicit backend of the released scorer.
reference_dispatch.official_default_dispatch_cases: Meta reference chooses its default CPU SDPA backend. The released scorer retains its explicit MATH backend.

reference_sampling: Double-precision grid_sample on support-weighted official projection with border padding and align_corners=False; released head loaded independently.
